description: This Java class 'Module' constructs and manages project modules based on make files, handling dependencies, source files, and generating IDE configuration files.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a project module constructed from a make file, managing dependencies, source files, and IDE configuration generation.

methods.name: calculateRelativePartToRepoRoot
methods.description: Calculates relative path segments to the repository root.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Parses make file, builds dependency list, and dependent modules.

methods.name: getRelativeIntermediatesDirs
methods.description: Returns list of relative directories for intermediates.

methods.name: getExcludeDirs
methods.description: Returns list of directories to exclude.

methods.name: isAndroidModule
methods.description: Checks if the module is an Android module by presence of AndroidManifest.xml.

methods.name: findSourceFilesAndImplicitDependencies
methods.description: Finds source files and implicit dependencies based on make file values.

methods.name: buildDependencyList
methods.description: Builds list of direct and implicit dependencies.

methods.name: parseDirectDependencies
methods.description: Parses direct dependencies from make file for given key.

methods.name: buildImlFile
methods.description: Generates IDE module file (.iml) based on current module configuration.

methods.name: buildIntermediates
methods.description: Builds XML string for intermediates directories.

methods.name: buildDependentModules
methods.description: Builds list of dependent modules and their dependencies.

methods.name: getAllDependencies
methods.description: Returns set of all dependencies (direct + implicit).

methods.name: getAllDependentImlFiles
methods.description: Returns set of all dependent IML files.

methods.name: buildAndroidFacet
methods.description: Builds XML configuration for Android facet in IDE.
